lane_disposition: Prospective 60/40 start follows current phase protocol; preserve original advice separately. Both are forecasts, not retrospective quotas.
question: Can an ordinary finite ADD producer deliver the same current, independently checked certificate service as the accepted portfolio/value representation, and what construction/export/edit/check/storage work is necessary?
success_criteria: Specify a common receiving service and trust boundary with explicit source, scope, edit and failure behavior.
Construct and independently check an ordinary ADD-to-evidence bridge in an accepted finite fragment, or prove a precisely scoped expansion obstruction.
Charge construction, export, edits, checking, storage and setup for every credible method; admit shared algorithms and ordinary shortcuts.
Preserve initial failures and adverse comparisons; distinguish source/tariff-specific economics from semantic equivalence or generic lower bounds.
Assess five questions and 21 duties, contribution delta, exact clocks and next boundary; preserve existing source-bound evidence.
failure_criteria: An unsupported compactness/complexity claim or a producer-only comparison used as an end-to-end result.
A receiver trusting the producer root, missing hypotheses, malformed evidence, stale warrants or uncharged material work.
Artificially excluding an ordinary DAG certificate or exact-table shortcut to manufacture a separation.
reliable_gain: A reproducible equal receiving-service bridge and full finite resource contract from existing ADD/portfolio interfaces.
exploratory_gain: Determine when compressed evidence can remain compressed through export and edits, or identify a receiver-format-specific exponential expansion and a fair alternative.
first_informative_check: Inspect the actual receiving certificate syntax and the parity-family ADD; attempt one minimal root-to-certificate bridge and identify precisely where sharing is retained or duplicated.
likely_failure: Small producer diagrams can still expand in a tree-only receiver, and identical ordinary proof kernels can erase an apparent value-representation advantage.
literature_target: Primary ADD/BDD and knowledge-compilation proof/checking antecedents, including complexity hypotheses and exact representation scopes.
timing_rule: Only observed principal D/L/E qualifies; setup, publication, waits, recovery and overlapping agents earn zero research credit.
